issues.description: The Stock.findStockIngredient method signature is inconsistent: the problem statement and the solution expect a single-argument method findStockIngredient(String) (returning StockIngredient), but the template Stock.java provides only a two-argument method findStockIngredient(String, boolean). This mismatch will confuse students and prevent them from calling stock.findStockIngredient(name) as described in the task and used in examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Stock API match the specification and solution by adding the single-argument method findStockIngredient(String) (returning StockIngredient). A safe change is to add an overload: public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) { return findStockIngredient(name, true); } or implement the single-argument variant directly so students can call stock.findStockIngredient(name) as described.
